Exercise 1: Create a training Dockerfile

Note — Learning outcomes By the end of the exercises, we expect you to be able to do the following:

  • Write/create a basic Dockerfile that can run a basic DS project
  • Explain the workflow and processes for using Docker
  • Motivate the typical ways why you would modify Docker containers at runtime
  • Describe image repositories and explain their usage
  1. Set up a project folder with the training script Create a new project directory and copy in the training script from resources/train.py:
    mkdir my-docker-project
cp resources/train.py my-docker-project/
cd my-docker-project

    The script trains a LogisticRegression classifier on the Iris dataset and saves the model to artifacts/model.pkl. You will also need a requirements.txt listing the packages it depends on.

  2. Create train.dockerfile You can use your favourite tool to do this. Or do:
    touch path/to/project/train.dockerfile
  3. Find appropiate base-image A python:3.x image, for example python:3.11.
  4. Modify example Dockerfile to fit our use-case Inspired from this website:
    
FROM python:3.11
WORKDIR /usr/local/app
# Install the application dependencies
COPY requirements.txt ./
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
# Copy in the source code
COPY train.py ./
# Setup an app user so the container doesn't run as the root user
RUN useradd app
USER app
CMD ["python", "train.py"]

Next: Exercise 2 - Build the Image
